title: WOS Studio (Authoring) — Source-Authority Registry
description: Corpus-level catalog classifying each SourceDocument's standing as a class. Per studio/specs/source-authority-registry.md. Distinct from AuthorityRank (per-subject reviewer-judgment ranking) and OriginClass (per-claim provenance category). Registry classes the source; AuthorityRank ranks for a subject; the two compose. The registry is the structured input to retrieval authority rerank, AI-extraction automationEligibility gating, and freshness signaling. A single document under this schema MAY carry one SourceAuthority (singleton form) or many entries (collection form).
$comment: Promotion status (Stage-8 enhancement, 2026-05-08): MVP shape; freshnessSignal recomputation rules and supersession-link semantics evolve as the retrieval router (E2) and AI-extraction (Stage 8 deliverable 7) consume the registry.

x-lm.intent: Document type marker for the Studio Source-Authority Registry

$wosStudioSourceAuthority.description: Document marker pinning this artifact to the Studio Source-Authority 1.0 schema.

SourceAuthority.description: Classification of a SourceDocument's standing as a class. authorityClass is the load-bearing field; it determines automationEligibility defaults and feeds retrieval authority rerank.

sourceDocumentRef.description: SourceDocument id this entry classifies. MUST resolve to a real SourceDocument in the workspace's Source Vault (per SA-MUST-srcauth-001).

authorityClass.description: Standing of the source as a class. Determines default automationEligibility and authority rerank weight. Per SA-MUST-srcauth-010.

x-lm.intent: Source standing classifier — load-bearing for AI-extraction automationEligibility gating and retrieval authority rerank

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction the source is authoritative within. Free-form; recommended to align with effectiveness-and-applicability.md jurisdiction taxonomy.

examples: Texas Health and Human Services Commission

effectiveRange.description: Temporal range during which this source's authority is in effect. effectiveStart MUST be set; effectiveEnd is open-ended for indefinitely-current sources.

supersededBy.description: Reference to a SourceAuthority that supersedes this one. When set, this entry's automationEligibility MUST be `searchOnly` (per SA-MUST-srcauth-021).

freshnessSignal.description: Coarse freshness indicator. `unknown` is admitted but should not gate automation; downstream consumers (retrieval router) treat `unknown` as `aging` for ranking.

automationEligibility.description: Whether AI extraction may promote claims sourced from this document past `extracted`. Default for `unknown` authorityClass MUST be `reviewOnly` (per SA-MUST-srcauth-030 default-bridge).

x-lm.intent: AI-extraction promotion gate — load-bearing for AI-LINT-002 extension

classifiedBy.description: IdentitySubject that authored this classification. `subj-system` for the flat-default-bridge entries shipped at Stage-8 close.

rationale.description: Reviewer rationale for the classification. REQUIRED when authorityClass is one of {officialLegalEdition, officialAgencyGuidance, officialPolicy, officialForm} per SA-MUST-srcauth-011.

then.$comment: Per SA-MUST-srcauth-011: official-tier classifications MUST carry a reviewer rationale; unknown / unofficial / internal tiers MAY omit it.
Per SA-MUST-srcauth-021: a superseded SourceAuthority MUST carry automationEligibility=searchOnly. Reviewers pin a successor by setting supersededBy on the older entry.
Per SA-MUST-srcauth-030: unknown authorityClass MUST NOT carry canDriveAutomation. Default-bridge entries for the Stage-8 ship use reviewOnly.
